conflicts.framework_status: CODE, FINAL, AI EDIT, MMTX and study 70 remain conceptual variants. Order/filename establishes neither precedence, executable code, a physical law nor a change to host time or numerical kernels.
conflicts.framework_needs: RENDER.STANCE need/access declarations are setting concepts; they issue no food, water, shelter, clearance, immortality or simulated objects.
conflicts.framework_gate: Relational Red Gate language does not remove the documented/game access boundary or open a route.
conflicts.character_identity: Beck is a source persona with an authored transition history, not a player identity. A Nailyn engram depiction does not establish the missing person as present, alive or recruitable.
conflicts.spectrum_labels: Poster genre names and numeric tiers remain original text. Rose uses the requested druid / nano / neon spectrum; material tiers are not rules of skill, moral, cultural or gameplay superiority.
conflicts.map_authority: The original interpreted drawings retain navigation authority: ENACT upper left, Red Gate / Scarlet Plateau toward lower right. Poster compositions add no coordinates or destinations.
conflicts.khi_condition: IMAGE 18 suggests a free tent-maintaining Khi; the AETHERGALE DOCX and study 19 retain Khi in a prism. Do not spawn an available Khi from the inconsistent image.
conflicts.scale_claims: Heights, 1.5x comparisons, kilometers, miles and Greatweb extents are inconsistent source-specific prototype claims, not a world-grid or physics calibration. Preserve vast-world framing through percept/detail hierarchy.
conflicts.tower_variants: Rings vary from solid inhabited structures to thin lightPRKT fields. Study 27 forbids bridges while other variants show them. Keep siblings without choosing final topology, traversable rings or active portals.
conflicts.tower_hills_label: Study 32 labels ENACT integration within a tower composition; it establishes neither regional co-location nor a relocated hub.
conflicts.mesas_labels: The Mesas panorama includes WN_REZ / Lower Burgs labels associated elsewhere with WN_TOWER. Do not transplant those districts into Mesas.
conflicts.aquisphere_tree: Study 15 is labeled AquiSphere but borrows ArK branch/trunk/root callouts and a tree silhouette. Study 47 is spherical; neither establishes a final morphology.
conflicts.city_orientation: City studies 21–23 describe an eastern city; 25 says far northwest and no physical proximity to the southern gate. Preserve the existing interpreted atlas position.
conflicts.composite_geography: Composite sheets reuse regional/district labels. Juxtaposition does not establish proximity, a route, shared jurisdiction or a present object.
conflicts.hills_variants: Studies 38–39 name six peaks; 40–45 explicitly leave them unnamed. Grave-site placement, mid districts and orbit diagrams also vary. Retain DOCX jurisdiction and do not choose a peak taxonomy automatically.
conflicts.unlabeled_studies: Sphere studies resemble AquiSphere and monumental trees resemble the ArK, but association is unconfirmed. They remain unassigned and outside current-region guidance.
conflicts.manifestation_permissions: A pictured utility, vendor, transfer anchor or credential creates no inventory, services, clearance, free supplies, simulated mechanism or teleport route.
conflicts.image_readouts: Integrity percentages, verification states, cycle labels and engagement logs are concept-image pixels, not live telemetry.
conflicts.battle_scenarios: Fractbound Covenant, Enneract Trinode, Duskvoid Syndicate and Node 7B are proposed scenario elements. Different allegiances/objectives do not become live factions, NPCs, contracts or events.
conflicts.null_report_variants: NULL_FIELD constructs stay reported/unresolved. Directions, station links, annotation positions and scale vary; images confirm neither material composition nor a route beyond Red Gate.
